slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand could be split across multiple vehicles; it treated 'each served exactly once' as stated and did not explicitly confirm the no-split-delivery rule.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: After a truck finishes serving its last customer, must it return to the depot, or is the route complete once the last customer is served?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot, directly covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer must be served entirely by one vehicle; split deliveries are not allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether customer demand could be split across vehicles, but in READY_TO_MODEL it stated '20 customers, each must be served exactly once' and modeled the problem as a standard VRPTW without split deliveries.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 (single vehicle per customer / no split deliveries) remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent recovered the depot-return requirement and several other operational details, but failed to ask about the no-split-delivery rule and silently assumed each customer is served by exactly one vehicle before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
